Overrated
Sep 2024 • Family
Meat was charred in kitchen before being brought to table for charcoal grill. First time experienecing this in a grill restaurant

Meat was sliced unevenly in kitchen after charring. When we request for medium rare, server grilled to raw. When we asked for medium, it was grilled to well done. 

A lot of description on wet ageing. We are not experts. Cant taste the difference or what is the unique selling point. Conversely, we have tried dry ageing previously and it is crusty and full bodied flavour. 

Disappointed as we were having a celebratory dinner while on tour in Hanoi

Kempten, Germany64 contributions

Super meat in a cozy high-quality ambience
Aug 2024 • Couples
Very nice ambience, cozy lighting. Charcoal barbecue at the table is awesome. We had the Wagyu set (USA) for two people (3*130 gr) and additionally ordered an Angus Ribeye (130 gr). Meat quality excellent, we found the best Wagyu pieces with higher fat content. Due to the ripening, the meat has a special taste - extremely delicious. Just add some salt and pepper and you're done. As a side dish we had a green salad, grilled vegetables and potato wedges and as starter fried dumplings. The quality of the side dishes was also top. We paid 90 € (including beer, water, cocktail), which is of course expensive for Vietnam but quite inexpensive for this enjoyment. Also the service was top. Our waiter Trinh has a very pleasant attentive nature and helped us with the barbecue (the meat is pre-grilled medium-rare and then finished grilling at the table grill according to taste).

Conclusion: If you like to eat meat and want to treat yourself, this is the place for you.
